news.title: DataGrail report finds your vendor may be sending data to AI models you never approved
news.summary_raw: The data processing agreement (DPA) — the bedrock contract companies use to evaluate how vendors handle personal data — can no longer be trusted at face value. That is the central, and arguably most alarming, conclusion of DataGrail's Privacy and AI Trends Report 2026, released today.The San Francisco-based privacy platform analyzed 2,400 popular business software providers and found that 63.6% of vendors that prominently advertise AI capabilities do not disclose a third-party AI subprocess
news.summary: DataGrail's report found that 63.6% of vendors promoting AI capabilities do not disclose third-party AI subprocessors, indicating a lack of transparency in data processing.
news.enterprise_use: Review vendor data processing agreements (DPAs) for third-party AI subprocessors disclosure, and update your vendor risk management process to ensure compliance with data residency and consent policies.
